visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against individually viewed local Qualla front, courtyard, garden and portal originals. Pink three-storey street front has grouped casements, green shutters with red panel borders, window baskets and the carved entrance. Yellow rear house and lower garden wing frame the small courtyard. Final roof review restored both rear dormers, their peaked caps, the small high vent and the partly obscured upper rear window.
